speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and current use of natalizumab, which carries a significant risk of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML), I need to confirm if you have experienced any new visual changes, cognitive decline, or weakness alongside your ataxia. Please describe any recent changes in your vision or mental status, and confirm if your ataxia has worsened since starting natalizumab. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with contrast showing PML changes.

speaker: Patient
